5. Forms and mandatory data
Fields marked as mandatory are necessary to handle the relevant request. If they are not provided, it may not be possible to respond to the request or provide the requested functionality.

The data protection information displayed alongside forms supplements this Policy. Where consent is requested for an optional purpose, such as certain commercial communications, it will be presented separately and will not be pre-selected.
6. Data retention
Data will be kept for as long as necessary to fulfil the purpose for which they were collected and, subsequently, for the periods during which legal liabilities may arise.

Enquiries and business opportunities: while there is interaction or a reasonable prospect of a business relationship, and afterwards for the period necessary to address possible liabilities or requests.
Customers: during the contractual relationship and afterwards for the applicable statutory periods.

Consent-based commercial communications: until consent is withdrawn or the right to object is exercised, without prejudice to retaining the evidence necessary to demonstrate the preference or consent.
7. Recipients and technology providers
Rooklyn may use providers that process data to deliver technology services necessary for its business. Depending on the actual configuration of each site or service, these may include:
Web hosting, DNS, security and content delivery providers, including Cloudflare when active.
GoHighLevel / HighLevel for CRM, forms, automations, opportunities and communications.
Email and calendar providers.
Messaging providers, including WhatsApp/Meta when that channel is used.
Infrastructure, automation or artificial intelligence providers that are necessary to provide specific functions and are properly configured.

Rooklyn does not sell personal data. Where a provider acts as a data processor, the relationship will be governed in accordance with applicable requirements. Data may also be disclosed where there is a legal obligation.
8. International transfers

Some technology providers may be established or process data outside the European Economic Area. Where an international transfer is subject to the GDPR, a valid mechanism will be used, such as an adequacy decision, standard contractual clauses or another safeguard recognised by applicable rules. You can request further information about the applicable safeguards using the email address specified in this Policy.
9. GoHighLevel and forms

Certain Rooklyn forms and processes may be integrated with GoHighLevel / HighLevel. Information supplied may be added to the CRM to handle requests, contact the data subject, schedule demonstrations or meetings, manage follow-ups and retain the communication history relating to the request.
10. Áurea Clima and demonstration environments

Áurea Clima is a sales demonstration environment used to show examples of automation and management applicable to the air-conditioning and HVAC sector. Data entered into active demonstration forms will be processed under this Policy when Rooklyn receives them for its own purposes.
Users must not enter particularly sensitive data, health data, confidential third-party information or real customer data that are unnecessary for the demonstration.
11. Automated decisions and profiling

Rooklyn may use automations to classify requests, create tasks, assign statuses or facilitate internal follow-ups. Unless expressly stated otherwise, these automations are not used to make decisions based solely on automated processing that produce legal effects concerning the data subject or similarly significantly affect them.
12. Data subjects’ rights
Where applicable, you may exercise your rights of access, rectification, erasure, objection, restriction of processing and portability, and withdraw consent where processing is based on it.

To exercise your rights, you can write to geet29.dubey@gmail.com with “Data protection” in the subject line and provide the information necessary to identify the request. We may request additional information where reasonably necessary to verify the requester’s identity.
13. Complaint to the supervisory authority

If you believe the processing of your personal data infringes the rules, you may lodge a complaint with the Spanish Data Protection Agency (AEPD), whose information and procedures are available at https://www.aepd.es.
14. Security

Rooklyn will implement appropriate technical and organisational measures, taking into account the nature, scope, context and purposes of processing and the level of risk. No system connected to the Internet can guarantee absolute security.
15. Third-party data
Anyone supplying third-party data must have a lawful basis for doing so and provide only the information necessary for the relevant purpose.
16. Minors
Rooklyn services are primarily intended for businesses and professionals. We do not intend to knowingly collect minors’ data through commercial forms or demonstrations.
